description: This file contains miscellaneous utility function declarations, macros, and inline functions related to buffer management, byte order conversions, and memory allocation routines for a reftable library in a Git-related project.

methods.name: reftable_buf_init
methods.description: Initialize the buffer for use, equivalent to REFTABLE_BUF_INIT for stack variables.

methods.name: reftable_buf_release
methods.description: Release memory associated with the buffer and reinitialize it for reuse.

methods.name: reftable_buf_reset
methods.description: Reset the buffer size to zero without releasing memory.

methods.name: reftable_buf_setlen
methods.description: Set the buffer length, appending a NUL byte, with success indicated by 0.

methods.name: reftable_buf_cmp
methods.description: Lexicographically compare two buffers.

methods.name: reftable_buf_add
methods.description: Append bytes to the buffer, handling arbitrary byte sequences.

methods.name: reftable_buf_addstr
methods.description: Append a null-terminated string to the buffer.

methods.name: reftable_buf_detach
methods.description: Detach the internal buffer and transfer ownership to the caller.

methods.name: void reftable_put_be16(void * out,uint16_t i)
methods.description: Encode a 16-bit integer in big-endian format.

methods.name: void reftable_put_be24(void * out,uint32_t i)
methods.description: Encode a 24-bit integer in big-endian format.

methods.name: void reftable_put_be32(void * out,uint32_t i)
methods.description: Encode a 32-bit integer in big-endian format.

methods.name: void reftable_put_be64(void * out,uint64_t i)
methods.description: Encode a 64-bit integer in big-endian format.

methods.name: uint16_t reftable_get_be16(const void * in)
methods.description: Decode a 16-bit big-endian integer from memory.

methods.name: uint32_t reftable_get_be24(const void * in)
methods.description: Decode a 24-bit big-endian integer from memory.

methods.name: uint32_t reftable_get_be32(const void * in)
methods.description: Decode a 32-bit big-endian integer from memory.

methods.name: uint64_t reftable_get_be64(const void * in)
methods.description: Decode a 64-bit big-endian integer from memory.

methods.name: binsearch
methods.description: Perform a binary search on a range, assuming ascending order.

methods.name: free_names
methods.description: Free a null-terminated array of malloced strings.

methods.name: parse_names
methods.description: Parse newline-separated list of names into an array.

methods.name: names_equal
methods.description: Compare two null-terminated string arrays for equality.

methods.name: names_length
methods.description: Get length of null-terminated string array.

methods.name: reftable_malloc
methods.description: Allocate memory, uses custom allocator.

methods.name: reftable_realloc
methods.description: Reallocate memory, uses custom allocator.

methods.name: reftable_free
methods.description: Free memory, uses custom allocator.

methods.name: reftable_calloc
methods.description: Allocate zero-initialized memory, uses custom allocator.

methods.name: reftable_strdup
methods.description: Duplicate a string, uses custom allocator.

methods.name: int reftable_alloc_size(size_t nelem,size_t elsize,size_t * out)
methods.description: Calculate total allocation size with overflow check.

methods.name: void * reftable_alloc_grow(void * p,size_t nelem,size_t elsize,size_t * allocp)
methods.description: Grow an allocation based on doubling strategy.

ctags.name: reftable_alloc_grow
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void *reftable_alloc_grow(void *p, size_t nelem, size_t elsize,$/

ctags.name: reftable_alloc_size
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int reftable_alloc_size(size_t nelem, size_t elsize, size_t *out)$/
